We need to decide relation between two yes/no questions.

Q1: "A vacinação contra Covid-19 deve ser obrigatória para crianças de 6 meses a 5 anos a partir de 2024?" This asks about mandatory vaccination for a specific age group (6 months to 5 years) starting 2024.

Q2: "A vacinação de crianças contra a COVID-19 deve ser mantida?" This asks whether vaccination of children (general) should be continued/maintained. Not specifying mandatory, age range, or start date.

These are different questions: one about mandatory for a specific age group and timeframe; the other about maintaining vaccination (presumably existing policy) for children generally. The answer to one does not determine the other. So relation = DIFFERENT.
